recognize_zh: 中央的漿細胞核偏心、核周較淡，細胞質外緣呈洋紅色（magenta）不規則的火焰狀邊緣，即 flame cell；左側另見染色質細緻的不成熟漿細胞，右側為深藍細胞質的漿細胞。
features: Central plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus and abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm shows a pale-blue perinuclear zone and an intensely magenta, ragged peripheral fringe (flame cell)
Adjacent immature plasma cell with larger nucleus, finer chromatin and pale-blue cytoplasm
Right-sided plasma cell with clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing
Maturing granulocyte (band/metamyelocyte) at top; crenated red cells from drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several plasma cells, including a flame cell with an eccentric nucleus and abundant cytoplasm whose periphery stains intensely magenta with a frayed border. An adjacent plasma cell has finer chromatin and a larger nucleus, consistent with an immature form, and a third plasma cell shows basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof. A maturing granulocyte and crenated red cells are also present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with flame cell morphology, a pattern classically associated with IgA myeloma but not specific.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, polytypic and usually perivascular without immature forms, whereas neoplastic cells show atypia and kappa/lambda restriction.

ddx.dx: Mott cell / Russell body plasma cells
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale-blue Russell bodies rather than a diffuse magenta peripheral cytoplasmic fringe.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic granules distributed over the cytoplasm, a paranuclear Golgi zone but a central-ish nucleus with nucleolus, and lack the eccentric clock-face nucleus of plasma cells.
LPL cells are smaller with less cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes, and carry MYD88 L265P rather than showing atypical immature plasma cells.
